definitions.explanation: A person who submits articles, essays, or other written works to a publication, often as an outside writer rather than a staff member.

examples.japanese: {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
この{雑誌|ざっし}の{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}には{有名|ゆうめい}な{作家|さっか}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This magazine has many famous authors among its contributors.

examples.japanese: {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}として{新聞|しんぶん}にコラムを{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I write a column for the newspaper as a contributor.

notes:
A compound of {寄稿|きこう} (contribution of a manuscript) + {者|しゃ} (person). {寄稿|きこう} itself combines {寄|き} (to send, to contribute) + {稿|こう} (manuscript, draft). Used in publishing, journalism, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}を{募|つの}る: to call for contributors
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}の{一覧|いちらん}: list of contributors
- {外部|がいぶ}{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}: outside contributor
- {定期|ていき}{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}: regular contributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}: writer, author — more general, referring to anyone who writes, while {寄稿者|きこうしゃ} specifically implies contributing to an external publication
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}: poster, submitter — used more broadly including social media posts and reader submissions, while {寄稿者|きこうしゃ} implies a more formal contribution
